{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue to float, removing commas
completed['revenue_float'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA orders in completed set: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Remove QA orders
completed_clean = completed[~qa_mask]

# Recompute mean revenue
mean_revenue_clean = completed_clean['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f'\nMean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA): {mean_revenue_clean:.2f}')"}
